items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: Jazz Is magazine, the Fagans, the husband and wife, great people individually, they were great together too.

ctx.x: Do you pay much attention to your competitive magazines?

I used to when I was younger. And then, and I think it was probably around the 2008, 9, when the big recession hit and you know both of my major U.S. competitors, we can say the names, JazzTimes and JazzIz, they’re friends of mine. JazzIz went dark and was sold and came back out. But they had some financial issues and they could no longer do it.
